text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown brilliantly seizes the glory 
of victory. Her rivals felt the sting of 
defeat, yet found renewed inspiration to 
fight on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She vowed to hang on to the very end. To 
snatch that crown away, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The brighter her rivals shine, the 
stronger Satono Crown becomes. Because—she 
is an Umamusume who can overcome any 
adversity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Through tireless effort and flawless 
preparation, she will continue to make 
miracles happen. Together with the Trainer 
she trusts so deeply—"
